github.get-issue.v1.name: Get Issue (Agent)
github.get-issue.v1.description: Fetches the full details of a single issue by number.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Repository owner login (user or org). Resolve via List My Repositories or Search Repositories.

issue_number.name: Issue Number
issue_number.description: The issue (or pull request) number. Resolve via List Repository Issues or Search Issues and Pull Requests.

drive.get-file.v1.name: Get File or Folder
drive.get-file.v1.description: Get a file folder for files/sub-folders

file_id.name: File / Folder ID
file_id.description: The ID of the file/folder to fetch. Resolve it via `drive_search_files` or `drive_list_files`.

drive.find-files.v1.name: Search Files and Folders
drive.find-files.v1.description: Search a Google Drive folder for files/sub-folders

query_term.name: Query Term
query_term.description: The Query term or field of file/folder to search upon.

value.name: Value
value.description: Value of the field of file/folder to search for.

parent_folder_id.name: Parent Folder ID
parent_folder_id.description: (Optional) Restrict the search to files/folders inside this folder ID.

include_team_drives.name: Include Team Drives
include_team_drives.description: Determines if folders from Team Drives should be included in the results.

drive.list-folder.v1.name: List Folder Contents
drive.list-folder.v1.description: List files from a Google Drive folder

folder_id.name: Folder ID
folder_id.description: The ID of the folder to list. Resolve it via `drive_search_files` (or any other source).

include_trashed.name: Include Trashed
include_trashed.description: Include new files that have been trashed.

depth_level.name: Depth Level
depth_level.description: How many levels deep to search for files. 1 = current folder only, 2 = current + next level, etc.

download_files.name: Download Files
download_files.description: Download all file contents in a list

include_team_drives.name: Include Team Drives
include_team_drives.description: Determines if folders from Team Drives should be included in the results.
